name: Concrete Slab Cost Calculator
description: Calculate concrete slab cost instantly. Enter length, width, and thickness to get cubic yards, bags, and total cost including labor.
inputs: Length, width, thickness (with unit toggle), waste factor, price per cubic yard
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = length * width * (thickness/12). Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27. Add waste factor. Multiply by price per yard. Labor = area * rate.

name: Rebar Spacing Calculator
description: Calculate rebar spacing, grid layout, and total linear feet for concrete slabs and footings. Free tool for contractors and DIY.
inputs: Slab length, slab width, rebar spacing, overlap per splice, bar size (with unit toggle)
formula: Bars per direction = ceil(dimension_in_inches / spacing) + 1. Total linear feet accounts for overlaps based on slab length exceeding standard bar length.

name: Concrete Footing Calculator
description: Calculate cubic yards of concrete needed for footings and foundations based on width, depth, and total length.
inputs: Footing width, footing depth, total length (with unit toggle)
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = (width/12) * (depth/12) * length. Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27. Add 10% waste.

name: Roof Pitch Calculator
description: Convert between roof pitch, angle, and slope. Calculate rafter length and total roof area from your measurements.
inputs: Rise, run, building width, eave overhang (with unit toggle)
formula: Pitch ratio = rise:run. Angle = arctan(rise/run). Slope % = (rise/run)*100. Pitch multiplier = sqrt(1 + (rise/run)^2). Rafter length = half-span * multiplier.

name: Shingle Calculator
description: Calculate how many bundles of shingles you need for your roof. Enter roof area and pitch to get instant bundles, squares, and waste factor.
inputs: Roof length, roof width, roof pitch, waste factor (with unit toggle)
formula: Roof area = footprint * pitch_multiplier. Squares = roof_area / 100. Bundles = squares * 3. Add waste factor 10-15%.

name: Tile Calculator
description: Calculate how many tiles you need for any floor or wall. Includes tile count, boxes, thinset, and grout estimates.
inputs: Room length, room width, tile dimensions, waste factor (with unit toggle)
formula: Room area = length * width. Tile area = (tile_width * tile_height) / 144. Tiles = ceil(room_area / tile_area * (1 + waste/100)). Thinset bags based on trowel size.

name: Paint Calculator
description: Calculate how many gallons of paint you need for walls, ceilings, and trim. Free estimator for any room size.
inputs: Room dimensions, ceiling height, doors, windows, coats (with unit toggle)
formula: Wall area = perimeter * height - doors - windows. Gallons per coat = wall_area / 375. Total = gallons_per_coat * coats.

name: Concrete Column Calculator
description: Calculate concrete volume for round or square columns. Enter diameter and height to get cubic yards and bag count.
inputs: Column shape, diameter or side, height, number of columns (with unit toggle)
formula: Round: volume = pi * (diameter/24)^2 * height. Square: volume = (side/12)^2 * height. Multiply by number of columns. Convert to cubic yards.

name: Gravel Calculator
description: Calculate how much gravel you need for driveways, walkways, and landscaping. Enter area and depth for instant tons and cubic yards.
inputs: Length, width, depth, gravel type (with unit toggle)
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = length * width * (depth/12). Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27. Tons = cubic yards * 1.4 (varies by type).
